seo.h2: Play Battleship Online — Free, No Download
seo.intro: Battleship Online is a free, browser-based version of the classic naval strategy game. Hide your fleet on a 10×10 grid, then take turns firing at your opponent's hidden ships until one fleet is sunk. Play solo against a smart computer AI or challenge a friend to real-time 2-player online multiplayer — no download, no sign-up, and no ads. It runs instantly on desktop and mobile.
howToSteps: Pick a mode — battle the computer (Easy, Medium, or Hard) or start a multiplayer room to play with a friend.
Place your fleet — position your five ships on the grid. Press Rotate (R) to flip a ship, or hit Random for an instant layout.
Take turns firing — click a square on your opponent's grid to fire. A hit is marked in red, a miss in grey.
Sink every ship — the first admiral to sink the entire enemy fleet wins the battle.
features: Single-player vs AI with three difficulty levels — from random shots to probability-based hunting.
Online 2-player multiplayer — create a room and share the code or link to play a friend in real time.
Free and instant — no account, no install, no download required.
Plays anywhere — works in any modern browser on desktop, phone, or tablet.

faqs.q: Is Battleship Online free to play?
faqs.a: Yes. It is completely free with no sign-up, no ads, and no download required — just open the page and play.

faqs.q: Can I play Battleship online with a friend?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Multiplayer, create a room, and share the room code or link. You play a live 2-player game against each other in real time.

faqs.q: Do I need to download or install anything?
faqs.a: No. Battleship Online runs entirely in your web browser, so there is nothing to download or install on desktop or mobile.

faqs.q: Can I play Battleship against the computer?
faqs.a: Yes. Single-player mode lets you battle an AI opponent with Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels.

faqs.q: Does Battleship Online work on mobile?
faqs.a: Yes. The game is designed to work on phones and tablets as well as desktop browsers.
